notes: Source = enacted Public Law 119-62 text (9705 chars, read in full). No referencedSources registered on the analysis and none needed (self-contained enacted text; the cited FAA Reauth Act of 2018 / 43 USC 2802(a), MAPLand Act / 16 USC 6851, and 43 USC 776 are named only as coordination anchors, not figure sources). Every substantive prose claim is source-supported. Zero material issues. Flags are all MINOR: (1) analysis attributes the Sec 4 publication duty to the five named agencies though the statute places it on "the Secretaries" (defensible mapping); (2) the navigable-waters savings statement is placed inside the Section 4 detail though it derives from Sec 7; plus three MINOR omissions (Sec 4(f) irrigation-canal/flowage exclusion, Sec 4(g) historic/paleontological/archaeological non-disclosure, Sec 4(b)(2) bathymetric data).
